Implementation done. `safe_upload_path` in `uploads.py` strips any directory components from the untrusted filename (handling both `/` and `\` separators), rejects empty/`.`/`..` filenames, then resolves the joined path with `os.path.realpath` and verifies containment under the resolved `base_dir` via `os.path.commonpath` — this also catches symlink-based escapes where a file inside `base_dir` is itself a symlink pointing outside.

Added `test_uploads.py` covering: normal join, `../` traversal, absolute-path input, Windows-style traversal, empty/`.`/`..` rejection, and a symlink-escape case. Not executed, per your instruction to just write the code and stop.
